author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In the collection archive of Cinema Relics, Adam meets some of the most iconic and treasured hand props from the Indiana Jones movies! Collector and prop historian Dan Lanigan shares the stories of hero props like the Golden Fertility Idol from the beginning of Raiders of the Lost Ark and the iconic Headpiece to the Staff of Ra! 

Learn more about Cinema Relics prop investigations at: https://www.youtube.com/@cinemarelics/videos
Indiana Jones Golden Fertility Idol: Secrets of an Iconic Movie Prop: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gv03qvuo0To
Unboxing Screen Used Sankara Stones from Indiana Jones & The Temple of Doom: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-k9-JNph3ZM
The Secret Genius Behind Indiana Jones's Costumes: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lSYr2cU9dyE

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
